newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: ADB grants $90 mln loan for Vietnam finance sector.
newsitem.headline: ADB grants $90 mln loan for Vietnam finance sector.

text.p: The Asian Development Bank (ADB) has approved a $90 million loan to Vietnam to implement reforms in the country's financial system, the bank said on Friday.
In a statement, the ADB said Vietnam will implement a programme that will entail the establishment of essential market infrastructure to facilitate private sector participation.
Other components of the programme include the commercialisation of domestic banking operations, promotion of competition and development of the capital market.
Beside the loan, the ADB also approved an $850,000 technical assistance grant to help demonstrate to banks the benefits of adopting modern systems and techniques.
